No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-17678 existed on the combined branch.

The current source already no longer presents the snippet as an unqualified complete resource instance and now shows an Observation snippet under the requested constrained-StructureDefinition framing. The remaining awkward wording is editorial, not a conformance-changing defect.
